row.scim_price_text: Standard $3.65 + Atlassian Guard Standard $4.20 per user / month (monthly billing)
row.evidence: Bitbucket's pricing table marks "Atlassian Guard (SSO, audit logs)" as "Requires Atlassian Guard subscription" on Free, Standard and Premium, and Atlassian Guard Standard ($4.20 per user / month) includes "SCIM automated user provisioning".
row.notes: New row. Bitbucket Cloud users are Atlassian accounts, so SCIM is Atlassian's organization-level user provisioning, sold in the Atlassian Guard add-on (Guard Standard $4.20/u/mo monthly billing; annual billing is per user tier, e.g. $4,200/yr for 51-100 users). Bitbucket prices are the monthly-billing prices shown by default (Standard $3.65, Premium $7.25); scim_price_per_user_mo = Standard + Guard Standard. Big caveat: IdP group sync is not yet available for Bitbucket, so SCIM creates, updates and deactivates the Atlassian account but cannot grant Bitbucket workspace access by group. SCIM DELETE deactivates. Bitbucket's own REST API is read-only for workspace members (2.0); group and invitation management still uses supported 1.0 endpoints. IdP apps are the Atlassian Cloud apps; Okta's standalone 'Bitbucket' app is SWA only and Entra's 'Bitbucket by resolution GmbH' app is a third-party SAML app.

endpoints.notes: The API intro lists schemas and resources ("Get schemas and resources"); individual Schemas/ServiceProviderConfig/ResourceTypes pages could not be loaded this session (renderer retries exhausted).

operations.notes: Group sync does not reach Bitbucket: groups push into the Atlassian organization but group-based Bitbucket access is not yet supported.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivation keeps the Atlassian account's personal data so it can be reactivated; SCIM DELETE deactivates and unlinks rather than deleting the account.

custom.how: No arbitrary custom attributes documented; responses also carry urn:scim:schemas:extension:atlassian-external:1.0 atlassianAccountId.

roles.how: No SCIM role attribute; in Atlassian, app access comes from groups, and group sync is not yet available for Bitbucket.

limitations.text: Syncing groups from the IdP is not yet available for Bitbucket (only Jira, Confluence and Trello), so SCIM manages the Atlassian account but not Bitbucket workspace group access.
SCIM DELETE does not delete the account; it deactivates it.
Group renames are not supported over SCIM.
Guard Standard allows one identity provider; multiple IdPs need an Enterprise plan.

capabilities.notes: Bitbucket's 2.0 API is read-only for members; group membership and invitations use the 1.0 endpoints Atlassian still supports until Bitbucket moves to the Atlassian Cloud Admin API. Account lifecycle is in the Atlassian admin APIs, not Bitbucket's.

endpoints.purpose: Get user membership for a workspace
List user permissions in a workspace
List groups in a workspace (1.0, still supported)
Add a member to a group
Remove a member from a group

rate_limits.text: Authenticated requests: 1,000 per hour rolling for most API resources (scaled limits for some); anonymous: 60 per hour.

limitations.text: No Bitbucket endpoint creates users; Bitbucket users are Atlassian accounts created through invitation, SCIM or the Atlassian admin APIs.

okta.notes: Provisioning goes through the Atlassian Cloud OIN app (SAML, SCIM, Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push/Group Linking checked in page markup). The separate 'Bitbucket' OIN app (last updated Nov 2019) is SWA only.

entra.notes: Via the Atlassian Cloud gallery app. The Entra 'Bitbucket by resolution GmbH' app is a third-party SAML SSO app with JIT, not provisioning.

google.notes: Via the Atlassian Cloud app; Google requires SSO set up first.

onelogin.notes: From Atlassian's own docs; OneLogin's connector page was not loaded (bot protection).

jumpcloud.notes: Via the Atlassian Cloud app; jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-bitbucket returned 403.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace user sync and Azure AD for nested groups into the Atlassian organization (Atlassian docs).

Atlassian's default groups page lists bitbucket-users-{enterprise-name} app-access groups, while the provisioning page says group sync is not yet available for Bitbucket.
